source_text.body:
Run fitness, meal planning and weekly shops
A commenter uses a Claude agent for macros, weekly shopping, meal planning and workout programming, plus a personal assistant app tracking purchases and home tasks.
·
Nov 17, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
A commenter said they use a fitness and nutrition agent to manage macros and micros, plan weekly shops and meals, generate workout programming, and guide meal-prep steps. Separately, they built a personal assistant app with voice wake words, speech-to-text, ElevenLabs voice replies, and tool use for browsers, calendar, email, shopping, and smart-home control, with the AI reporting back after actions.
How it went
They said it can buy items on a managed prepaid card, book restaurants, handle email and calendars, and even planned and purchased a Halloween outfit they called their best ever. They also said the mobile voice flow is still a little delayed.
Worth knowing
For purchases, they limit risk by giving the AI a preloaded card they keep under a few hundred dollars.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Act as my fitness and meal planning assistant. My goal is [goal], my stats are [height, weight, activity level], and I eat [diet or restrictions] with a weekly food budget of [amount]. Give me daily macro targets, a 7-day meal plan, a grocery list grouped by store section, and a [number]-day-a-week workout program using [equipment available].
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1xy177a/what_are_some_genuinely_useful_ways_youre_using
